summary_md: **deaglepc ([@DeaglePc](https://x.com/DeaglePc/status/2116067145662742690))** explains that Docker's **MCP Gateway** can allowlist only the tools you need from a given MCP server and group servers into exportable profiles; standalone CLI users must enable profiles first ([docker/mcp-gateway](https://github.com/docker/mcp-gateway)).
